sections.title: Group and item wrappers
sections.what: Builds the group container and each item. The group shares its size and style with its items through the shared context, so every button in the group looks consistent.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps all buttons in one group the same size and style. Otherwise reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: A group size or style overrides the item's own setting.

summary: A row of connected toggle buttons where the group shares its size and style with each button.
purpose: Lets the user pick one or more options from a set of connected buttons, such as text alignment choices.
why: Likely reason: lets one place set the size and style for every button in a group. Otherwise reason not stated in the code.
how: The group component wraps the Radix toggle group and passes its size and variant to its buttons through a shared context. Each item reads that context and uses the shared toggle styles. If the group sets no value, the item uses its own.
inputs: Group settings from Radix, an optional variant and size. Each item has its content and optional variant and size.
outputs: A row of buttons, with pressed buttons showing the on look.
risks: When the group sets a size or variant, the item's own setting is ignored without any warning.
debug: If a button looks unstyled, check that it sits inside a ToggleGroup and that toggle.tsx is imported correctly. If an item ignores its own size, check whether the group sets one.
